DARV.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-0.a: Finally! Someone who understands the value of some good scrap!
DARV.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-1.c: Someone who admires automation? Finally, language I understand...
DARV.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-2.a: Well, take a gander at these wares. Perhaps something to help you on the road ahead!
Back for some more materials, my [gold]Engineer[/gold] friend?
DARV.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-0.c: Very good, I was hoping to find you again Darv.
DARV.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-1.a: My wares tend to have that effect on people
DARV.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-2.a: You know the [sine]DRILL[/sine] by now, heh... anything interest you?
NEOW.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-1.c: My factory.... Where has it gone?!
What [sine]delightful[/sine] room have I come across now?

Now now, no need for that my new friend
Come forward, I shall bestow some of my power upon you.
My favorite factory builder returns once more! Let me bestow more tools upon you to help build the path to victory
I can see glimpses of strange lands in your eyes, you remind me of your [gold]Regent[/gold] friend.
I have automated many worlds... Nauvis, Vulcanus, Fulgora, [sine][green]Gleba[/green][/sine]...
How fascinating... Let me bless thee and you can tell me more of these worlds...
OROBAS.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-1: This place gets more and more confusing by the minute...
OROBAS.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-2: Confusing not bad! Mysteries fun! Much to learn! Here... Take this shiny... learn...
OROBAS.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.1-0:
Tell me stories other traveller of space!
Take this shiny and tell me stories!
OROBAS.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-0: I see I have found my way back here Orobas...
OROBAS.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-3: Impressive! Happy! A shiny for you!
PAEL.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-0.c: Is... Is that a... Dragon? Are you [sine]kidding[/sine] me right now???
PAEL.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-2.c: And the dragon just spoke... of course, what other laws of reality will be violated today???
PAEL.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-3.a:
[thinky_dots]Only the ones which are flawed from their conception...
Take from me to understand...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]The builder with the many questions returns...
Take from me and find your answers...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-0.c: My journey to victory over the [red][jitter]Architect[/jitter][/red] once again brings me to you...
PAEL.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-1.a: [thinky_dots][red]Father[/red] will not be beaten so easily... Why not sleep and find peace...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-3.a: [thinky_dots]Are there not some aspects of nature that you cannot choose...?[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-1.a: LEAVING ALREADY? COME AND FIGHT, GROW STRONGER!
TANX.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-2.c: I'd rather not be sent back to the bottom...
TANX.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.0-3.a: THEN CHOOSE A MIGHTY WEAPON! BUT FIGHT NEXT TIME, YOU MUST!
TANX.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.2-2.a: YEEES!! CONSTRUCTS AS WEAPONS, GLORIOUS BATTLE!! TAKE A WEAPON!
Oh my, what a [jitter][b]unique[/b][/jitter] vistor! And who are you, dear?
I am an [gold]Engineer[/gold], but I don't suppose you know-

That you are a builder?
Now now, come, have some [jitter][b]treats[/b][/jitter] for the road.

Back again my engineer friend?
I have some more [jitter][b]treats[/b][/jitter] for your journey!
Welcome back builder! Still having fun out there?
I suppose, although that pest at the top is preventing me from getting [sine][red]back to work[/red][/sine].
Well, kill him [jitter][b]quickly[/b][/jitter] would you? I'm sure you will find that task sufficient for now.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGIN: So you are the one who took my factory?
There is no automation to be had in this realm.
Back again? And with such mechanised nonsense?
I will automate this land like the [jitter]many[/jitter] before!!!
Another from the stars? Will wonders never cease?
But of course, builder of wonderous machines... I think we can help each other.
VAKUU.talk.SPIREOFFACTORIO-ENGINEER.1-0r: Care to sign another contract today my builder friend?
Do you have anything that will [sine]actually[/sine] help me defeat [red]The Architect[/red]???
He has wounded us both, do you really think these contracts benefit him in any way???
If you cannot uphold you end of the bargain... Then how about you sign a new contract to make it easier????
